component.name: Catfyn
component.summary: A no-nonsense Jellyfin client for TV screens

description.p: Catfyn plays films and series from your own Jellyfin server on a TV, driven with nothing more than arrow keys, OK and Back. It finds servers on your network, keeps several accounts, resumes where you stopped, follows your subtitle settings and offers the next episode when the credits start. Playback is done by mpv.
